Growth Plan.commentary: Built for businesses expanding beyond one location, with stock transfers, user roles, and low stock alerts to keep every site in sync.
Growth Plan.insightQuote: Growth shouldn't mean losing control — the right systems scale with you.

Business Plan.insightQuote: Established businesses deserve systems as sophisticated as their ambitions.
